observations: Public outdoor capture and rendered novel viewpoints show the reconstructed subject and surrounding scene.
Predicted RGB, distance, and opacity are separate, accurately labeled timelines.
Measured native metrics and public attribution are readable at desktop and mobile widths.
The report explicitly limits evidence to Gaussian appearance and excludes collision/navigation readiness.
